subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should session startup intentionally skip existing `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files larger than 1 MiB, rather than preserving their current loading behavior?
rationale: The implementation prevents unbounded allocations, but choosing to discard established project instructions on upgrade is a user-visible compatibility policy that code review cannot safely infer.

options.title: Cap prompt inputs only
options.body: Keep descriptor-bound limits for explicit and discovered prompt-input files while preserving existing project-context loading until a separately approved contract is defined.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB context cap
options.body: Accept the warning-and-skip behavior as the supported upgrade contract and record the owner decision with focused upgrade documentation or tests.

options.title: Choose another context strategy
options.body: Specify a different bounded behavior, such as a larger approved limit or defined truncation semantics, before implementing it consistently.

recommendation.title: Cap prompt inputs only
recommendation.body: Keep descriptor-bound limits for explicit and discovered prompt-input files while preserving existing project-context loading until a separately approved contract is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for an unresolved repository-level compatibility decision.
